title: SAGE: Semantic Audio Generative Encoder
abstract: arXiv:2609.32755v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Audio autoencoders compress waveforms into compact latent representations that serve as the interface between raw audio and downstream models. Current systems navigate a three-way trade-off between reconstruction quality, semantic structure of the latent space, and inference speed, typically favoring one or two of these at the expense of the others. This paper introduces SAGE, Semantic Audio Generative Encoder: a compact variational autoencoder, trained solely on publicly available music, that shapes its latent by distilling embeddings from a pretrained audio-text model. This 105M-parameter model runs about 3x faster than Stable Audio Open and reaches the listening-test quality of SAME-L, an autoencoder 8x larger and over 2x slower, while surpassing both on objective perceptual and distributional metrics of reconstruction. translated_abstract: 音频自编码器将波形压缩为紧凑的潜在表示，作为原始音频与下游模型之间的接口。现有系统需要在重建质量、潜在空间的语义结构和推理速度之间进行三方权衡，通常只能以牺牲其他方面为代价来优化其中一两个方面。本文提出了SAGE（语义音频生成编码器）：一个紧凑的变分自编码器，仅使用公开可用的音乐进行训练，通过从预训练的音频-文本模型中蒸馏嵌入向量来塑造其潜在空间。这个1.05亿参数的模型运行速度比Stable Audio Open快约3倍，并达到了SAME-L（一个参数量是其8倍、速度慢2倍以上的自编码器）的听感测试质量，同时在重建的客观感知指标和分布指标上超越了上述两个模型。此外，它在全部十九个潜在语义探测任务上都达到了最先进的水平，无论是域内还是（原文摘要到此截断）。
tldr: SAGE是一个仅1.05亿参数、只用公开音乐训练的紧凑音频自编码器，通过蒸馏预训练音频-文本模型的嵌入来构建语义潜在空间，在推理速度、重建质量和语义结构三方面同时超越了现有的更大模型。
en_tdlr: SAGE is a compact 105M-parameter audio autoencoder trained solely on public music that shapes its semantic latent space by distilling embeddings from a pretrained audio-text model, simultaneously outperforming much larger existing models in inference speed, reconstruction quality, and semantic structure.
